title: China's Humanoid Robots Went From Hundreds To 50,000
source: Morgan Stanley research (via BigGo Finance / Futu News, June 2026): roughly 16,000 humanoid robots deployed worldwide in 2025, with China accounting for more than 80% of that; Morgan Stanley raised its 2026 China humanoid shipment forecast to 50,000 units (from an earlier 28,000 estimate), its second upgrade in six months. 2023-2024 figures are approximate, back-modeled from the reported pilot-to-commercialization ramp (China's earliest factory/warehouse humanoid pilots began around 2023). 2026 rest-of-world figure is an approximation derived from Morgan Stanley's stated ~80% China share.
